standing.description: Claim standing (ADR-0009). human_approved > crm_explicit > first_party_record > first_party_ai > third_party.

recordOrigin.description: Where a SourceEvent comes from (WP32, HAR-131). live: a connector observing the real world. dataset: a replay of a third-party dataset (e.g. CRMArena-Pro, itself synthetic). synthetic: generated by our labelled synthetic layer. Absent means not declared (legacy and hand-written fixtures). Stored for audit on source_events only; it is deliberately not carried onto activities, state or agent context, so no learner can key on it.

recordProvenance.description: Versioned name of the dataset or generator that produced a non-live SourceEvent, '<name>:<version>', e.g. 'synthetic:v1' or 'crmarena-pro:b2b'.

relationshipState.description: Relationship-state vocabulary (ADR-0012). A state is earned by a CONFIRMED StateTransition, never assigned. Upper case so it is never confused with the CRM opportunity motion (new_business/expansion/renewal), which is only a supporting fact. Must equal the state_transitions CHECK lists (migration 0013).

descriptions.NEW_LOGO: Pursuing a first commercial relationship with an account that is not yet a customer.
descriptions.EXPANSION: An existing customer is growing (seats, teams, business units, products) with a stable owner and an active commercial process.
descriptions.RENEWAL: An existing contract is up for renewal and the commercial focus is retaining it.
descriptions.RECOVERY: Customer risk dominates (support incident, dissatisfaction, renewal concern); the relationship must be repaired before any commercial ask.
descriptions.REORG: Relationship disruption: the champion moved, left or changed responsibility, ownership is unclear, or the buying group is no longer reliable.

relationshipStateOrUnknown.description: A relationship state, or the literal 'unknown' (the repo-wide unknown value) while no transition has been confirmed.

transitionStatus.description: StateTransition status (HAR-97 pitch §2, ADR-0012). CONFIRMED: enough first-party evidence that the account moved. CANDIDATE: meaningful new signals, at least one required fact missing. UNRESOLVED: the graph changed but the target state is not clear (no target). REJECTED: a suspected transition was decisively contradicted by later evidence. CONFIRMED, REJECTED and a closed (stale) UNRESOLVED are terminal.

ruleSetVersion.description: Version of the transition rule set (contracts/transitions/rules.v1.json); same pattern as the state_transitions.rule_set_version CHECK.

factKey.description: Requirement or contradiction key from the transition rule set (contracts/transitions/rules.v1.json).

relType.description: Relationship (edge) vocabulary of the activity graph. Must equal the relationships.rel_type CHECK list (migration 0006).

stateRef.description: Points at one materialized state snapshot. Without opportunity_id: the account roll-up, state_history (account_id, version), version >= 0. With opportunity_id: that opportunity's state, opportunity_state_history (opportunity_id, version), version >= 1 (ADR-0016).

graphDiffRef.description: Points at the node/edge changes one projection step made to the Neo4j context graph (HAR-129 section 1B). `id` is the source event whose diff this is: the id GET /events/{id}/graph-diff takes (a source_events id, not the replay dataset's event id). The sequence numbers are graph projection job ids (graph_projection_jobs.id): job ids are one global counter shared by every account, so the range is bounded by the account's own jobs. from_projection_seq is the account's previous projection job before the first job that touched the event (0 when the account had none), to_projection_seq is the last job of the account that touched the event.

eventProvenance.description: Where a replay event came from, in the vocabulary of SourceEvent origin/provenance: origin 'dataset' is the base dataset replay (provenance e.g. 'crmarena-pro:b2b'), 'synthetic' is the labelled synthetic layer (provenance 'synthetic:v<N>'). A synthetic event is never presented as original dataset data (HAR-129 section 1). source plus source_event_key is the ingest idempotency key the event will carry.

changeDimension.description: What kind of business change an event or a claim reports (HAR-129 section 1 case-selection list).
